name: Ham and Potato Soup
desc: Creamy, thick potato soup with diced ham and celery, thickened with a butter and milk roux.

source.title: Delicious Ham and Potato Soup
source.evidence: All eleven ingredients and amounts match this page line for line, as does the two-pot method (simmer the vegetables, thicken with a separate roux).

ingredients.raw: 3 1/2 cups peeled and diced potatoes (1/2-inch dice, about 3 medium russet or Yukon Gold)
ingredients.note: 1/2-inch dice, about 3 medium russet or Yukon Gold

ingredients.raw: 1 tsp ground white or black pepper
1/2 tsp fine salt, or to taste

steps: Combine the potatoes, water, ham, celery, and onion in a large pot. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce to medium and simmer until the potatoes are fork-tender, 10-15 min.
Stir in the bouillon granules, pepper, and salt.
Meanwhile, melt the butter in a medium saucepan over medium-low heat. Whisk in the flour and cook, stirring constantly, until thick and smooth, about 1 min.
Slowly whisk in the milk a little at a time so no lumps form. Keep stirring over medium-low heat until the sauce is thick enough to coat a spoon, 4-5 min.
Stir the milk mixture into the soup pot and cook, stirring, until heated through, 2-3 min. Taste for salt and serve hot.
tips: Bouillon granules are salty; taste the soup before adding the 1/2 tsp salt.
